player_prompt.intro:
Kemm ad ikkan Player {player_id} ({role}) deg urar n Matching Pennies i {num_rounds} n tuzzya.
- Yiwet n tuzzya, azen [heads] neɣ [tails] (neɣ [h], [t]).
- Ma yella tekcemt-ik tifrat-ik d tin n uɣellaṣ-ik, Player 0 itar-itt tuzzya; neɣni Player 1 itar-itt.
Ssawel-d tifrat-ik s tɣarast '[heads]' neɣ '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Amyar 0 ifer {choice0}; Amyar 1 ifer {choice1}. Yemɣer -> Amyar 0 itṛejja
message.round_mismatch: Amyar 0 ifer {choice0}; Amyar 1 ifer {choice1}. Ur yemɣer ara -> Amyar 1 itṛejja
